clients.name: D'oro Italian Bar
clients.address: Perú 159, C1067AAC Cdad. Autónoma de Buenos Aires, Argentina
clients.summary: D'oro Italian Bar is a long-standing Italian restaurant in Buenos Aires, established in 1999, specializing in pasta and offering a wine bar with imported Italian wines, an online wine store, and a private event space. Located in a historic area, it emphasizes fresh ingredients and quality service.
